// Generated by CrossGL for WebGPU WGSL

struct Uniforms {
    u_time: f32,
    u_resolution: vec2<f32>,
};
@group(0) @binding(0)
var<uniform> _Uniforms: Uniforms;

fn bitOf(lane: f32, stage: f32) -> f32 {
    return ((floor((lane / pow(2.0, stage)))) - ((2.0) * floor((floor((lane / pow(2.0, stage)))) / (2.0))));
}

fn hash(n: f32) -> f32 {
    return fract((sin((n * 12.9898)) * 43758.5453));
}

fn laneCentre(lane: f32, warp: f32, x: f32, laneH: f32, bandH: f32) -> f32 {
    var stage: f32 = ((floor(x)) - ((4.0) * floor((floor(x)) / (4.0))));
    var phase: f32 = fract(x);
    var ease: f32 = (smoothstep(0.1, 0.45, phase) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.55, 0.9, phase)));
    var dir: f32 = ((bitOf(lane, stage) * 2.0) - 1.0);
    var amp: f32 = ((pow(2.0, stage) * laneH) * 0.5);
    var drift: f32 = ((sin((((x * 2.3) + (lane * 0.9)) + (warp * 1.7))) * laneH) * 0.15);
    return ((((((lane + 0.5) * laneH) + (warp * bandH)) + (bandH * 0.1)) + ((ease * dir) * amp)) + drift);
}

@vertex
fn vertex_main(@location(0) a_pos: vec2<f32>) -> @builtin(position) vec4<f32> {
    return vec4<f32>(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
}

@fragment
fn fragment_main(@builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
    var uv: vec2<f32> = (position.xy / _Uniforms.u_resolution);
    var laneCount: f32 = 16.0;
    var warpCount: f32 = 3.0;
    var bandH: f32 = (1.0 / warpCount);
    var laneH: f32 = ((bandH * 0.8) / laneCount);
    var warp: f32 = floor((uv.y * warpCount));
    var local: f32 = (((uv.y - (warp * bandH)) - (bandH * 0.1)) / laneH);
    var lane0: f32 = floor(local);
    var t: f32 = (_Uniforms.u_time * 0.05);
    var x: f32 = (((uv.x * 2.4) + t) + (warp * 1.37));
    var line: f32 = 0.0;
    for (var j: i32 = -8; (j <= 8); j = (j + 1))     {
        var lane: f32 = (lane0 + f32(j));
        var inLane: f32 = (step(0.0, lane) * step(lane, (laneCount - 1.0)));
        var centre: f32 = laneCentre(lane, warp, x, laneH, bandH);
        var dpx: f32 = (abs((uv.y - centre)) * _Uniforms.u_resolution.y);
        var weight: f32 = (0.5 + (0.5 * hash((lane + (warp * 31.0)))));
        line = max(line, (((1.0 - smoothstep(0.5, 1.4, dpx)) * inLane) * weight));
    }
    var edgeX: f32 = (smoothstep(0.0, 0.22, uv.x) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.84, 1.0, uv.x)));
    var edgeY: f32 = (smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.92, 1.0, uv.y)));
    var alpha: f32 = (((line * edgeX) * edgeY) * 0.85);
    var ink: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    var paper: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(1.0, 1.0, 1.0);
    return vec4<f32>(mix(paper, ink, alpha), 1.0);
}
